summary: Batangas 6th District representative with 112 principal-authored bills. Authored enhanced overtime pay for all employees, lower-cost prescription drugs, a Magna Carta for Taxpayers, tax amnesties, an estate tax amnesty extension, a plastic excise, petroleum excise suspension, three National Internal Revenue Code amendments and expanded employment anti-discrimination for women.
caveat: Direction of the NIRC amendments was not reviewed; the gender bill is a single social issue and unscored.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored enhanced overtime pay (-2) and lower-cost prescription drugs (-2), against tax amnesties and petroleum excise suspension (+1 to +2) and a plastic excise (-1).
